lista.titulo: Teen Titans Go! • Ghost With the Most
lista.descripcion: Ghost With the Most | When the Halloween Spirit is kidnapped, the Titans must team up with Beetlejuice to save the holiday.
Bucket List | The Titans give Starfire a bucket list of activities to accomplish.
Patty's Law | Apple and Onion must look after a sick Falafel in order to go parasailing.
The Eater | Apple and Onion take on a monster in a parallel universe in order to get back home.
Booth | Apple and Onion must save their favorite booth at Pizza's Diner from a Texas oil tycoon.
Ferekh | Apple and Onion have to get Falafel's beloved rooster back from scientists.

lista.titulo: What's New Scooby-Doo? • The Fast and the Wormious
lista.descripcion: The Fast and the Wormious | The gang heads to Mexico for the Enduro Slam 5000 off-road race.
Homeward Hound | Six priceless puppies and Scooby-Doo are kidnapped.

lista.titulo: The Scooby-Doo Show • The Headless Horseman of Halloween
lista.descripcion: The Headless Horseman of Halloween | The gang is having fun at a Halloween costume party with their friend who happens to be a descendant of Ichabod Crane. Their fun turns into a nightmare when the headless horseman shows up.

lista.titulo: The Scooby-Doo Show • Scared a Lot in Camelot
lista.descripcion: Scared a Lot in Camelot | Shaggy's uncle has inherited the old King Arthur castle and sent it to New England stone by stone; while visiting, the gang learns that he's also brought back the ghosts of Merlin and the Black Knight.
Canary Row | Sylvester spots Tweety inside the Broken Arms Hotel, but no cats are allowed in the lobby, so Sylvester has to think up other means of getting in.
Pop 'im Pop! | Sylvester Cat befriends a baby kangaroo who escapes from the circus.
Rabbit of Seville | Bugs and Elmer Fudd stage a bizarre version of "The Barber of Seville" after Elmer chases Bugs into a packed theater.

Superstocker | Tom's part-time job in a supermarket hits a snag when Jerry not only becomes a pest in the cheese department but when he turns the entire market into turmoil as he attempts to get Tom fired.
Surf-Bored Cat | Tom decides to go surfing but has problems with a shark and a rather tenacious starfish.

The Brothers Carry-Mouse-Off | Jerry uses radar to avoid any traps Tom has set up for him using food; Tom tries to dress up like a female mouse to trap Jerry, but he is foiled when other cats chase him.
TV Knight 6 | Batman is forced to go to the department store with Alfred but runs off to watch TV with Commissioner Gordon.
Kryptonite | When Robin explains that knowing your weakness makes you a better superhero, Starfire journeys to find hers.
Thumb War | As the other Titans engage in an all-out thumb wrestling war, Starfire tries to broker peace.
Toddler Titans...Yay! | Control Freak thinks the Titans' humor is too juvenile for their time-slot, so he ages them down to a preschool show.

lista.titulo: The Amazing World of Gumball • The Potato
lista.descripcion: The Potato | When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato; Darwin finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined, so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

lista.titulo: The Amazing World of Gumball • The Fuss
lista.descripcion: The Fuss | Nicole tries, and fails, to hide her disappointment when Richard and the kids fail to remember her special day; Richard has to figure out what special day he has actually forgotten and then make it a day to remember or else.

lista.titulo: The Amazing World of Gumball • The Outside
lista.descripcion: The Outside | The family goes to visit Richard's dad; Based on his basic living standards and extended absence from Richard's life, they assume Frankie must have done a stretch in the slammer.

lista.titulo: The Amazing World of Gumball • The Vase
lista.descripcion: The Vase | Sick of Granny Jojo's ugly gifts, Nicole encourages the kids to take matters into their own hands and accidentally break her latest hideous vase; when Gumball, Darwin and Anais try to destroy the vase, they discover it is more robust than it seems.

lista.titulo: The Amazing World of Gumball • The Matchmaker
lista.descripcion: The Matchmaker | Gumball enlists Carrie to help bring Darwin and Teri together, but when they can't make Darwin and Teri's love blossom naturally, they decide to make it happen supernaturally.

lista.titulo: The Amazing World of Gumball • The Box

lista.titulo: The Amazing World of Gumball • The Console
lista.descripcion: The Console | When Gumball is given a cursed video game console, Elmore becomes trapped inside a fantasy RPG world; Gumball, Darwin and Anais have to battle their way through town, unraveling the secrets of their new virtual reality.

lista.titulo: The Amazing World of Gumball • The Ollie

Family BBQ | Mordecai wants a handshake from Margaret's father.
